description: Typix plays typing sounds in text fields, with separate sounds for letters, capitals, space, Enter, Tab, Backspace, Delete and punctuation. Each character can have its own stereo position and pitch. Comes with mechanical keyboard packs and an editor to make your own, and can beep on misspelled words.
changelog:
### 1.0.1
* Typing statistics now open in a read-only field with a Close button: a short summary on the first line, then details for today, the last 7 days, all time and each recent day.
* Words you finish with Enter now count in the statistics.

### 1.0.0
* First public release.
* Typing sounds in text fields, with stereo position and pitch for each character, bundled mechanical keyboard packs, and a pack editor.
* Beep on misspelled words, spelling suggestions, and a custom dictionary.
* Text replacements and automatic capitals.
* Whole word echo after a correction, and typing statistics.
* English and Ukrainian interface and help.
* Needs NVDA 2026.1 or later.
